correctness.rationale: For each petal, private-path independence p and chosen-middle independence q determine α(S) without hub and max(Σp,1+Σq) with hub. Edge contraction preserves q and cannot increase p, hence gives a simplicial face map. Six local threshold pairs (p,q) show identity of empty/endpoint subcomplexes, path contraction, or full-simplex contraction; every local map is a homotopy equivalence. All finite intersections of threshold-cover joins are again productwise-minimum threshold joins and commute with the contraction, allowing finite homotopy-colimit gluing on deletion X and link L. The hub cone decomposition then supplies full map equivalence. For the square bouquets, a specified discrete-Morse pairing with monotone hub/middle/endpoint order leaves one critical 0-cell and binom(m,k-1) cells of dimension 2k-3, yielding the integral wedge. Independent induced-independence enumeration checks Euler and face counts at (m,k)=(1,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4); larger finite table and exact mod-2 Betti ranks in source corroborate. k=2 and contractible m<k-1 boundaries included.
